subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should GitHub-backed sources adopt persisted selectedSkillPaths as the source-selection contract, after fixing dry-run counts and refreshing the dirty draft?
rationale: The PR introduces a stored setting that changes sync scoping for existing and future GitHub-backed sources, so compatibility and operator semantics need maintainer ownership beyond line-level review.

options.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Paths
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, drop the merged warm-up overlap, make dry-runs selected-path-aware, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

options.title: Accept Stored Selection Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the persisted selected-path contract as-is, but would own the dry-run mismatch and upgrade proof gap.

options.title: Pause Selection Contract
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it if maintainers do not want selected skill paths to become persisted GitHub source configuration yet.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Paths
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, drop the merged warm-up overlap, make dry-runs selected-path-aware, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and most heavily maintained the GitHub-backed source sync contract this PR extends.
